descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S02 The same walk in Nursing Home: manual add, duplicate kept, chart opened, visit completed, task completed and deleted

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Adding a patient by scan and by manual entry is logged, each add tagged by method (scan vs manual), in Hospital and in Nursing Home (UAT OAT-06 Test 1; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 1; TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 Analytics)
  • U3 A duplicate-detection prompt logs that it was shown, and logs whether the physician accepted or rejected it (manual add and scan, both contexts) (UAT OAT-06 Test 3; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 1; TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 AC 5)
  • U6 Completing an encounter fires both timestamps (Pre-Round summary opened, note marked complete), and they aggregate per physician per day (UAT OAT-06 Test 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 4)
  • U8 Completing a task and deleting a task are logged as separate events; task reminders are tracked live (completed vs deleted logged separately) (UAT OAT-06 Test 7; UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 1; UAT TC-24; TFA-94514 AC 2)
  • U15 Usage analytics rows carry no patient content (no name, MRN, room, diagnosis, task text or note text), so rows that outlive a deleted patient do not break the 36 h retention claim or TC-24's hard del … (UAT 3.6; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Fresh physician switched to Nursing Home; the seeded resident has a finished visit note and two open tasks; T0 recorded

When Add resident 'QA Resident OAT06 Manual'; add the same name again (no MRN, no date of birth) and answer Cancel; open {snfResident}'s chart on Pre-Round; on Post-Round complete task 1 (the first button in its row) and delete task 2 (the trash icon at the end of its row), then tap Mark Visit Complete

Then The same rows as S01 with careSetting nursing_home: patient_added manual x1, duplicate shown + accepted (addMethod manual), pre_round_summary_opened x1, note_marked_complete x1 (minutes numeric), task_completed x1, task_deleted x1; today's nursing_home rollup +1 on each counter; the hospital rollup row is unchanged; no patient content in any row. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.3 (both modes) applied to OAT-06 Test 1, 3, 5, 7. Same post-run reads as S01 with nursing_home. Checkpoints only show each step happened on screen (cp2 the list, cp3 the completed state)

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-06/S02

The same walk in Nursing Home: manual add, duplicate kept, chart opened, visit completed, task completed and deleted

Tickets: TFA-92580 Patient List Capture (Scan Census OCR + manual add) (rejected by qa); TFA-94514 Analytics tracking (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

Local QA stack only (main e02167f), a brand-new @roundai.test physician per test, synthetic charts deleted after the reads. No model: every ai/* action is refused at the Convex socket and none was sent; tripwire clean for the final run (16:43:28Z mark, 'no model call'). Rows are read with the local admin key (patientActivity / usage / surveys _recentForActor, usage:_dailyForActor) before and after the steps; reading them through Vikram's dashboard on the UAT deployment is S23 / Q12. Seeded one resident (In Today, finished note with billing pre-computed, two open tasks). Switched from the Hospital list with the Nursing Home toggle; header '+' (no accessible name, A1) -> Add Resident 'QA Resident OAT06 Manual', Unit / Room 'Long-Term Care · Rm 21'; the same name again (no MRN, no date of birth) -> confirm 'already in the resident panel' -> Cancel; opened the seeded resident on Pre-Round; Post-Round > Tasks: task 1's first (unlabelled) button = complete, task 2's trash = delete; Mark Visit Complete. Judged 15/15: 3 checkpoints and 12 row checks since T0: patient_added nursing_home/manual = 1; shown + accepted with the same promptId (nursing_home, manual), rejected = 0, one resident with the name, no patient_removed; pre_round_summary_opened, note_marked_complete (minutes 0), task_completed, task_deleted = 1 each, all nursing_home with the resident's id and no other usage row; nursing_home rollup +1 on preRoundSummariesOpened, notesCompleted, encountersTimed, tasksCompleted, tasksDeleted; hospital rollup row absent before and after (unchanged); no name, unit / room, MRN, diagnosis, task or note text in any row. Record-only: Cancel -> 'accepted' (Q5). Not part of this case: removing a resident (no Nursing Home screen can; known B24, S22 / Q4).

Evidence: 5 attached.
